claims.claim: Added exactly the six bounded TASK-121 public exports and four immutable evidence-profile value types, without persistence, mutation, retrieval, reconciliation, or raw-dict APIs.

Profile construction requires an exact CanonicalCatalogState, resolves one exact registered opaque variant ID, and enforces exact one-to-one ProductSourcePack identity binding before profile creation.

Projection follows registered member order, reuses canonical member identities, and preserves descriptive values, ProductFact objects, OriginalMediaRef objects, provenance, conflicts, and per-pack ordering exactly.
Construction is pure deterministic in-memory projection and invokes no resolver, admission, registration, persistence, I/O, ranking, retrieval, or external workflow.
TASK-117/TASK-118 behavior and prohibited implementation modules remain unchanged.
Added focused TASK-121 regressions and documented the profile as evidence projection only, with product-truth reconciliation, deterministic retrieval, and RAG deferred.
